Hi Alicia — thank you, noted.

Short plan below and owners listed. I attached a compact redaction playbook and a tiny log snippet for reference. If the auditors need a different format we can produce a CSV export as well.

Top-level guidance (summary):
- We never include raw customer prompts or full audio transcripts in runtime telemetry shared for audits; all exported traces are sanitized.
- Redaction tiering: 
  * Tier 1 (remove): direct identifiers (SSNs, PANs, full credit card numbers, unredacted credentials).
  * Tier 2 (hash/replace): account IDs, email addresses (replace with stable hashed value), customer internal IDs.
  * Tier 3 (scrub/trim): long free-text fields are truncated and noise-filtered; timestamps preserved.
- Metadata: keep request_id, model_version, and timing metrics; remove payload content except for redacted placeholders.

Owners for deliverables:
- Redaction Playbook (policy + examples): kimberly_park
- Sample runtime log snippet (sanitized): marissa_cole
- CAIQ subcontrol mapping + attachments upload: priyom_das

Delivery ETA: draft artifacts attached now for your review; final binder and DocuSign-ready attestation by 2025-09-11.

Next steps for MeridianBank: confirm whether auditors need CSV or JSON logs; confirm whether hashed IDs are acceptable or if you require pseudonymization.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

(attachments: redaction-playbook-v1.2.pdf, sample-runtime-logs-snippet.txt)

Alicia / Tom / Team —

Thanks for the fast feedback. Quick responses inline and attached an addendum to the playbook covering salt strategy and validation checks.

1) Hashing: we use HMAC-SHA256 with a per-customer secret (stored in the customer's KMS workspace) for any identifier that requires a stable pseudonym across traces. This ensures the salt is not global and can be rotated without re-hashing persisted telemetry.

2) Validation and sampling: automated redaction validators run as part of the ingest pipeline. Sampling cadence: nightly 0.1% automated sample, weekly manual QA on 25 samples per tenant during audit windows. Unit tests exist that assert pattern-based redaction for known PII formats (cards, SSNs, emails). The addendum includes example test cases.

3) Deliverables we will upload to your secure intake folder by EOD 2025-09-11:
- redaction-playbook-v1.2.pdf (with salt addendum) — owner: kimberly_park
- sample-runtime-logs-snippet.txt (sanitized) — owner: marissa_cole
- caiq-subcontrol-mapping.xlsx (mapping of statements to control IDs + artifact links) — owner: priyom_das

If that works, please reply with the intake drive link and we will start the secure upload.

Best,
Kimberly Park
